title: Sarvam Recognizer Options
description: Sarvam AI realtime STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'sarvam'. The recognizer language is mapped to a Sarvam Indian language code (e.g. en-US becomes en-IN); unsupported languages fall back to 'auto' detection. Every option is sent only when set.

language.description: Sarvam language code (e.g. hi-IN) or 'auto'. Overrides the recognizer language.

streamType.description: Latency/accuracy trade-off. Server default is balanced.

mode.description: Output mode. Server default is transcribe.

endpointing.description: vad (default) cuts finals on silence. With manual, jambonz sends no speech signals, so finals arrive only at session end.

prefixPaddingMs.description: Audio kept before detected speech, in ms (server default 300).

silenceDurationMs.description: Silence that ends an utterance, in ms (server default 500).

minSpeechDurationMs.description: Shortest speech treated as an utterance, in ms (server default 250).

keyterms.description: Terms to boost. Overrides recognizer hints. Sent only with saaras:v4.
